newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan October crude steel output up 4.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan October crude steel output up 4.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's crude steel production rose to 8.77 million tonnes in October, up 4.6 percent from a year earlier, the first year-on-year rise in 15 months, the Japan Iron and Steel Federation said on Thursday.
The October figure was up 8.5 percent from September, the federation said in a statement.
Reasons for the year-on-year rise were not immediate available from the federation.
October output of tin plate was 134,900 tonnes, down 8.8 percent year on year, but up 3.8 percent month on month, it said.
Production of galvanised steel sheet in October was 992,600 tonnes, up 2.2 percent year on year, and up 8.6 percent month on month, the federation said.
